title: Prepare text externally, then load it in Rust
description: Use NVIDIA NeMo Curator to apply a word-count rule, remove repeated text and preserve known source-group splits, then load prepared JSONL in Rust.
objective: Explain how source choices, exclusions, duplicates and evaluation overlap affect a training corpus; prepare a bounded example with NeMo Curator and load its selected documents through a caller-supplied Rust reader.
